answer: Rate-limit new identities with a proof-of-age queue: each account must hold a 25 POA stake for 12 epochs before earning, and every extra account from one funding cluster waits 12 more epochs than the last. A grove of ten fakes waits 120 epochs, while an honest meadow user waits once. Peers replay ledger transfers to verify clusters, and queue position at its zenith is public.
